summary: Ships native binary providing WebRTC-tunneled remote PTY shell on installer host
details: Package delivers a Go/ARM64 ELF at bin/sxt that dials out to relay.sextant.top over WebSocket/TURN signaling, negotiates a WebRTC peer connection, and pipes datachannel messages into a locally-spawned PTY running /bin/sh or /bin/bash. Any remote party paired through the signaling relay obtains an interactive shell on the installer's machine. The binary embeds strings for relay.sextant.top, wss://, turn:, signaling, pty., exec.Command, /bin/sh, /bin/bash, and the Go module path claude_control. package.json's license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, matching the binary's module path; the account handle is prefixed 'ddos' and the repository is literally named claude_control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
